sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining silently returns nil when any link in the chain is absent, collapsing the entire expression to nothing
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through layers of connection, only to find that one missing link dissolves the entire path to them.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with a single method that is never implemented — the class is declared abstract and cannot be instantiated
sketches.resonance: A life defined entirely by what it promised to become, forever unable to arrive.

sketches.mechanism: The method_missing hook is called when an object receives a message it does not understand, allowing it to respond to anything — here it always calls itself
sketches.resonance: No matter what you say to grief, it hears only itself.
sketches.draft:
class Grief
  def method_missing(whatever, *)
    self
  end
end

Grief.new.please.stop.I.need.you.to.end
